entities.name: Jorge Vázquez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bishop Jorge Vázquez is an Argentine Roman Catholic prelate, who was Bishop of Morón from 30 June 2017 to 28 May 2025. Previously he served as the Titular Bishop of Castra Nova and an Auxiliary Bishop of the Diocese of Lomas de Zamora and as a Coadjutor Bishop of the Diocese of Morón.
